description: Who may approve a change to a default (key binding, setting, Ghostty keybind, feature flag) so the defaults guard passes (scripts/ci/defaults_guard.py). The approval is a GitHub review on the pull request's head commit; the author's own never counts. An independent review receipt (`Review (<reviewer>): SHIP at <full head sha>`) from any member passes too, and a new setting that defaults to off needs neither. The guard reads this file from the base branch.
